chapters.title: CODEOWNERS Routes the Diff
chapters.blurb: A changed file falls through CODEOWNERS patterns until the last matching line wins, splitting into a human owner and a hidden agent reference.

chapters.title: One Reference, Three Native Formats
chapters.blurb: Three agent references resolve into three untranslated native config files, all normalized behind one shared review interface.

chapters.title: Base SHA vs. Head SHA
chapters.blurb: Configuration is read from the base SHA and code from the head SHA, so a pull request can never redefine the reviewer judging it.

chapters.title: The Worked Example, End to End
chapters.blurb: A real migration, a dependency bump, and a UI change move through CODEOWNERS routing, a blocking finding, a fix, and a green required check.

chapters.title: One Stable Check, Additive to Human Review
chapters.blurb: One stable required check fronts a growable roster of agents, additive to human CODEOWNER approval rather than replacing it.
